abstract: To allow for further discussion with China regarding the acts, policies, and practices at issue in this investigation, the U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) is modifying the action taken in this investigation to further suspend that action for two months, until January 10, 2027.
action: China's Targeting of the Maritime, Logistics, and Shipbuilding Sectors for Dominance

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: November 9, 2026: The actions taken in this investigation are further suspended through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on January 9, 2027.
title: Notice of Modification of Section 301 Action: China's Targeting of the Maritime, Logistics, and Shipbuilding Sectors for Dominance
